doc.title: Albert Warner and Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08

title: Superior Band, Marrero and other old bands
summary: Allen asks about Billy Marrero, the Superior Band, the Olympia and Keppard; Warner remembers the bands but not Marrero's father.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Do you remember Billy Marrero, Lawrence Marrero's father?
No, I don't remember him well. You don't remember?
You don't remember the superior band?
I remember the superior, but I don't know Marrero's daddy. I know his brothers, you see, I know all the boys, but I don't know the old man.
You heard it, you heard him I guess, and didn't know him. I didn't know him, you see. Cause I'm, he was, had the superior. Yeah. It was really his band.
Yeah, I remember the black, where they had, back in that time they had the superior and some other old band they had there. They had a lot of old bands.
Remember the Olympia band, or Keppert or anybody around here? Do you remember hearing Keppert when you were a kid?
